intro: Transform mealtime into a shared moment of joy with the Ace Pro dining set. Its compact design, cushioned seating, and robust wood frame make every meal the epitome of comfort and elegance​.

features.title: Built for strength
features.text: Our solid rubberwood construction ensures long-lasting durability and robust support for years of shared meals.

features.title: Compact and space-friendly
features.text: Tight on space? We get it. The square design fits smaller dining areas perfectly, combining practicality with a touch of elegance.

features.title: Smooth lacquer finish
features.text: Make every meal feel special—the MDF top’s rich lacquer finish creates a polished centrepiece for your dining area.

features.title: Comfortable cushioned chairs
features.text: Sink into comfort—soft, fabric-upholstered seats let you enjoy long meals without sacrificing support.

features.title: Ergonomic curved back
features.text: Long meals? No problem—the curved backrest supports your posture, keeping you comfortable as you linger at the table.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Ace Pro 4-Seater Wooden Square Dining Set
